description: Corrections to what AWS's Service Authorization Reference says these operations are authorized as, where a live call disagrees (scripts/iam.ts). Each `reason` is the evidence.

value.reason: iot:CreateThing, iot:DescribeThing, iotfleetwise:BatchCreateVehicle: The vehicle ARNs only exist after the call; iot:CreateThing / iot:DescribeThing are dependent actions when the association behavior auto-creates the backing IoT thing. iotfleetwise:TagResource: Needed only when the request sets tags; not granted, since tagging can change tag-based access.

conditional.iotfleetwise:TagResource: Needed only when the request sets tags; not granted, since tagging can change tag-based access.

value.reason: BatchUpdateVehicle is authorized per vehicle as iotfleetwise:UpdateVehicle (IoT FleetWise API reference); not verified live.
